facility.name: Cypress Trails Childcare Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 22801 ALDINE WESTFIELD RD, SPRING, TX, 77373

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Training hours for personnel staff was not made available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: One personnel file did not have the required 15 clock hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Three employees did not have form 2985 in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Three files did not have Form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation: One caregiver requires orientation training who was hired 8/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill was not conducted in the month of October 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Personnel records were not made available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Controlling Person: It was found that a controlling person ceased to be a controlling person in 12/2024, and a new individual who should have been a controlling person was not made a controlling person from 1/2025 to 6/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §744.305(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: It was found that director changes were not reported when a new director was made in 1/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §744.303(4))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: It was found that two subjects no longer associated with the operation do not have inactive background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: It was found that the people list had not been validated since 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Hours, Days, Months of Operation: It was found that the operation operates in the month of July while the current months for operating reflect that June and July the operation is closed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Hours, Days, Months of Operation (26 TAC §744.301(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There had not been a fire drill done for this school year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: A copy of a recent fire inspection report had still not been located.  An extension granted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §744.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees - 15 clock hours Annual Training for Caregivers & Site Directors: Two staff have not completed the required 15 clock hours of annual training for their respective training year. The caregivers will need to complete 15 clock hours of make-up training that will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees - 15 clock hours Annual Training for Caregivers & Site Directors (26 TAC §744.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: A copy of the most recent fire inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §744.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The center is not conducting fire drills during the hours of the after-school program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: A copy of the current health inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §744.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The Emergency Preparedness Plan is lacking the following information:  1. How children with limited mobility or need assistance will be evacuated  2. A copy of the evacuation and relocation diagram  3. How children will be accounted for at the relocations site  4. The emergency telephone number on file with Child Care Regulation  5. Who is responsible for communicating with local emergency authorities and Child Care Regulation  6. How the parent contact, emergency contact, emergency medical authorization forms and sign in/out logs will be evacuated  7. How children will be cared for until the emergency is over
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §744.501(22))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Of the two personnel records evaluated, one lacked a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Personnel files were not available for review for the director and two staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §744.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, four lacked the address for the emergency contact and one lacked the phone numbers for the emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation: Of the two personnel records evaluated, one has not completed orientation to the child care center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation (26 TAC §744.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director and one staff are not keeping a record of the dates and hours worked at the after-school care program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §744.801(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, two lacked authorization for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §744.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies is lacking the following information:  1. Hours, days, and months of operation  2. Meals that are served  3. How parents will be notified of policy changes  4. Procedures for parents to review and discuss questions or concerns with the director  5. Procedures for parents to visit the operation without prior approval  6. Procedures for parents to participate in the centers activities  7. Procedures for parents to review a copy of the operation's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online  8. Instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas   Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website  9. Staff vaccination policy
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §744.201(1))
